claims: AWS is a cloud computing provider.
Microsoft Azure is a cloud computing provider.
Google Cloud is a cloud computing provider.
Cloud providers use virtualization technology to divide physical servers into multiple virtual machines (VMs).
Users access virtualized resources via the internet from any device.
Cloud servers are housed in secure, dispersed data centers.
AWS EC2 is an IaaS service.
ICloud syncs photos, files, and data across Apple devices.
BigQuery is a data analytics service.
Cloud SQL is a database service.
Microsoft 365 and OneDrive are cloud-based productivity and storage tools.
